prerequisites: Knowledge of production means and raw material acquisition methods.
Even brief practical experience with production means in practical work sessions.
For example: Completion of one or two GM (Mechanical Engineering) units from the L1 and L2 course offerings.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the design of a manufacturing range.
Know and implement a numerically controlled production tool.
Design and implement a measurement range.

syllabus_topics: Reading geometric specifications and GPS standards
Developing ranges for medium, renewable series with machining-type production means
Numerical control of machine tools: programming, implementation, adjustment
Three-dimensional metrology: concepts, development of measurement ranges, implementation
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
